description: This file contains core implementations for handling git object files, including packing, unpacking, creation, validation, and access of loose and packed objects. It also provides transaction management for object storage and retrieval, cache management, and utilities for safe file operations related to git objects.

classes.name: struct odb_read_stream
classes.description: Base class for reading object streams from the object database.

classes.name: struct odb_loose_read_stream
classes.description: Represents a streaming object for reading loose objects with zlib inflation.

methods.description: Verifies the signature of an object file against its stored object ID.

methods.description: Streams the object data to compute its signature for verification.
